option.name: originalContent
option.value:
version: "3.8"
services: postgres: image: postgres:13.2-alpine environment: POSTGRES_USER: pawguardian POSTGRES_DB: pawguardian POSTGRES_PASSWORD: pawguardian volumes: - postgres-vol:/var/lib/postgresql/data networks: - database-network deploy: placement: constraints: [node.role == manager] endpoint_mode: vip # Change from dnsrr to vip healthcheck: test: [ "CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U pawguardian -d pawguardian" ] interval: 3s timeout: 3s retries: 10 start_period: 30s # Give it 30 seconds before checking
mongodb: image: mongo:7 volumes: - mongo-vol:/data/db networks: - database-network deploy: placement: constraints: [node.role == manager]
pgadmin: image: dpage/pgadmin4 environment: PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL: admin@pawguardian.com PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD: admin networks: - database-network deploy: placement: constraints: [ node.role == manager ] ports: - target: 80 published: 5050 protocol: tcp mode: host
backend: image: daniptrk/pawguardian-backend:latest environment: DB_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/pawguardian DB_USERNAME: pawguardian DB_PASSWORD: pawguardian # Force Java to wait and retry SPRING_DATASOURCE_HIKARI_INITIALIZATION_FAIL_TIMEOUT: -1 SPRING_FLYWAY_CONNECT_RETRIES: 10 SPRING_FLYWAY_CONNECT_RETRIES_INTERVAL: 10 networks: - backend-network - database-network deploy: replicas: 2 placement: constraints: [ node.role == manager ] # TEMPORARILY use manager max_replicas_per_node: 2 restart_policy: condition: on-failure delay: 20s # Much longer delay max_attempts: 10 # More attempts update_config: parallelism: 1 delay: 10s failure_action: rollback ports: - target: 8090 published: 8090 protocol: tcp mode: ingress
volumes: postgres-vol: mongo-vol:
networks: database-network: driver: overlay attachable: true backend-network: driver: overlay attachable: true
